description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wethara, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No, 520030
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration, ownership determinations, and property rights - all characteristics of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
